headline: Anthropic Poised for Stock Market Debut at $1.4 Trillion Valuation
summary: Artificial intelligence startup Anthropic, creator of the Claude AI assistant, is reportedly poised for a $1.4 trillion stock market debut just five years after founding.
why: Anthropic is a prominent artificial intelligence developer specializing in large language models and safety-focused AI research.

impacts.name: Anthropic
impacts.why: Anthropic is reportedly preparing for a initial public offering on the stock market.
